_comment: Tier-2: the KratosSwimmingDEMApplication wheel is stuck at 10.4.0 and pins kratosmultiphysics==10.4.0, so pip-installing it DOWNGRADES the core and breaks a newer stack. Pitfall (kratos.swimming_dem #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Verified against the index without installing it: the newest KratosSwimmingDEMApplication is 10.4.0 while every other application in this venv resolves at 10.4.3, so installing it would force the core down two patch releases. It was deliberately NOT installed — the fixture asserts its absence together with the presence of both prerequisites, so a future run that quietly installed it would go red. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. INDEX SHIFTED by the guidance reclassification; the claim this fixture verifies is unchanged and every #index quoted above is the current one. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS every claimed availability flag in CASES -- it asserts the opposite of what this install actually provides, leaving the importlib.import_module probe itself untouched. All 3 importable[...] lines then disagree with themselves and app_import_mismatches goes from 0 to 3. This is the control the fixture needs: it proves the printed booleans come from a real import attempt on this build and that a wrong availability claim is caught, rather than the fixture echoing a hard-coded table. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 3 importable[<app>]=<got>_expected=<must> lines, app_import_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/swimming_dem_wheel_pins_older_core && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
